title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
title_zh: 轻装上阵，随身携带：为长期规划智能体构建面向对象的上下文

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon .
paragraphs.zh: 长期规划智能体在持续的任务状态中积累进展，但会反复处理描述这些进展如何实现的交互历史。 这引出了一个自然的问题：长期规划的上下文是否可以转而围绕可重用的进展进行组织，而不是围绕产生这些进展的历史？ 在本文中，我们提出了 CarryOn——一种面向对象的上下文运行时，它将延续组织在可重用的任务对象周围。 CarryOn 并未将压缩后的历史或重建的进展记录作为延续的主要基础，而是从延续载体、互补的执行上下文以及近期交互的实时尾部构建上下文视图。 一个核心挑战是：在相关历史被弃用后，如何保持这一可重用基础的有效性？CarryOn 如何在每次折叠时更新该基础，而无需重建完整的表示？ CarryOn 会在多次折叠中保留载体记录，根据绑定证据和适用的环境检查修订受影响的记录，同时保留未受影响的记录并同步更新执行上下文。 在 OSWorld2.0 和 BrowseComp-Plus 上的实验显示，性能分别提升了 5.8% 和 7.0%，同时总令牌使用量分别减少了 51.9% 和 22.9%。 项目页面：https://ethannju.github.io/carryon .

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in two places: persistent task state, which embodies what has been achieved, and interaction history, which records how it was achieved ( Yi et al., 2026 ) . As shown in Figure 1 , once images have been inserted into a presentation or measurements have been entered into a report, the resulting task state already captures that progress for later steps to inspect and modify ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . As execution continues, this redundancy grows: agents repeatedly process accounts of how results already available in the task state were produced. Existing methods manage growing histories by summarizing, retrieving, or pruning past interactions ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Packer et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , or by translating them into explicit progress records and structured task states ( Wu et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . These approaches reduce context growth, but when they substitute for reusable task results, they make continuation depend on a redundant, selective account that can drift from the state the agent directly inspects and modifies.
paragraphs.zh: 长期规划智能体在两个地方积累进展：持续的任务状态，它体现了已取得的成果；以及交互历史，它记录了这些成果是如何实现的（Yi et al., 2026）。 如图 1 所示，一旦图像被插入演示文稿或测量数据被输入报告，由此产生的任务状态就已经捕捉了这些进展，供后续步骤检查和修改（Yang et al., 2024；Xie et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2026）。 随着执行过程的继续，这种冗余会不断加剧：智能体会反复处理关于任务状态中已有成果是如何生成的描述。 现有方法通过总结、检索或修剪过往交互来处理不断增长的历史记录（Wu et al., 2026b；Packer et al., 2024；Xiao et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026b；Kang et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2025），或者通过将其转化为显式的进展记录和结构化的任务状态（Wu et al., 2026a；Chen et al., 2026a；Wang et al., 2024）。 这些方法虽然减少了上下文的增长，但当它们替代可重用的任务结果时，会使后续执行依赖于一个冗余且选择性的描述，而该描述可能与智能体直接检查和修改的状态产生偏差。

paragraphs.en: We challenge this reliance on reconstructed accounts of progress with an object-oriented view of long-horizon context, in which reusable task objects form the basis for continuation. These objects include work products, source-grounded findings, and application states that remain usable under explicit conditions. The agent can recover relevant information through direct inspection and use of these objects, while context supplies the complementary information needed to continue. To realize this view, we introduce CarryOn, a context runtime that organizes the agent’s context into three complementary components: continuation carriers , which bind reusable content or object references to their conditions of use; execution context , which preserves active goals, applicable constraints, and unresolved issues not captured by the carriers; and live tail , which retains interactions since the most recent successful fold.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用一种面向对象的长期上下文视角，对这种对重构后的进展叙述的依赖提出挑战；在该视角中，可重用的任务对象构成了延续的基础。 这些对象包括工作成果、基于原始资料的发现以及可在明确条件下继续使用的应用程序状态。 智能体可以通过直接检查和使用这些对象来恢复相关信息，而上下文则提供延续所需的补充信息。 为实现这一视角，我们引入了 CarryOn——一种上下文运行时系统，它将智能体的上下文组织为三个互补的组件：延续载体（continuation carriers），用于将可重用的内容或对象引用与其使用条件绑定；执行上下文（execution context），用于保留载体未能涵盖的当前目标、适用约束和未解决的问题；以及活跃尾部（live tail），用于保存自最近一次成功折叠以来的交互记录。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge in building object-oriented long-horizon context is retiring interaction history once progress becomes reusable without losing the information required for continuation, which poses three challenges: 1) how to identify reusable progress beyond its surrounding history: Some results still depend on prior interactions for interpretation or use. CarryOn captures these dependencies as conditions of use explicit in continuation carriers. 2) how to maintain reusable progress as the task evolves: Retaining a record does not by itself establish that its content remains supported or its referenced state remains available. CarryOn binds updates to supporting sources and applicable environment checks; across folds, affected records are revised while unaffected records are carried forward. Finally, what must remain explicit when the corresponding history is retired: Task objects do not need to capture the goals, constraints, and unresolved issues that guide subsequent execution. CarryOn jointly updates continuation carriers and execution context to preserve this complementary information, while keeping recent interactions in a live tail. Once validated, these updates are committed through a fold , replacing the covered interaction history with the resulting object-oriented context view. In this way, CarryOn progressively reorganizes the long-horizon context around reusable task objects while preserving the information required for the agent to continue.
paragraphs.zh: 构建面向对象的长期上下文时，一个核心挑战是：在进展可被复用且无需丢失后续执行所需信息的情况下，如何淘汰交互历史。这带来了三个挑战：1）如何识别出可复用的进展及其超出周围历史的部分：某些结果在解释或使用上仍依赖先前的交互。 CarryOn 将这些依赖关系作为使用条件，明确记录在延续载体中。2）如何在任务演变过程中维持可复用的进展：仅保留记录本身并不能确保其内容仍受支持，或其所引用的状态仍然可用。 CarryOn 将更新与支撑来源及适用的环境检查绑定；在每次折叠操作中，受影响的记录会被修订，而未受影响的记录则被保留下来。 最后，当对应的历史被淘汰时，哪些信息必须保持明确：任务对象无需记录指导后续执行的目标、约束和未解决的问题。 CarryOn 会同步更新延续载体和执行上下文，以保留这些互补信息，同时将近期交互保留在动态的尾部中。 一旦验证通过，这些更新将通过一次折叠操作被提交，用由此生成的面向对象上下文视图取代所覆盖的交互历史。 通过这种方式，CarryOn 逐步围绕可复用的任务对象重组长期上下文，同时保留智能体继续执行所需的信息。

paragraphs.en: In our experiments, object-oriented context management improves task performance while substantially reducing context cost. Our method, CarryOn, lifts Claude Opus 4.7 from 43.9% to 49.7% (+5.8%) on OSWorld 2.0 for long-horizon computer use and from 49% to 56% (+7%) on BrowseComp-Plus for long-horizon browsing. At the same time, it reduces total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, and total cost by 35.9% and 7.1%, on the two benchmarks, respectively. Compressing history alone is insufficient for continued execution: organizing context around reusable progress improves over generic compression, while the full CarryOn runtime further improves over the same principles implemented through repeated summarization. Continuation carriers and execution context play complementary roles, and reusable progress is typically maintained across folds rather than repeatedly reconstructed.

paragraphs.en: Existing methods reduce long-horizon context by compressing, pruning, summarizing, or selectively retrieving prior interactions ( Wei et al., 2026 ) . Compression and pruning range from prompt-level compression ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) to removal of redundant or outdated interactions ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Summarization methods periodically replace accumulated interactions with compact reasoning states or learned summaries ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) , while branch-based execution can return only compact subtask results ( Sun et al., 2025 ) . External-history methods instead keep the active context bounded while preserving access to earlier interactions outside the prompt ( Packer et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and some systems validate compressed representations against subsequent execution to reduce information loss ( Chen et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过压缩、剪枝、摘要生成或选择性检索过往交互来缩短长时程上下文（Wei et al., 2026）。 压缩与剪枝的方法范围涵盖提示层级的压缩（Jiang et al., 2023; Jiang et al., 2024），到移除冗余或过时的交互（Xiao et al., 2026）。 摘要生成方法会定期用紧凑的推理状态或学习到的摘要替换累积的交互（Wu et al., 2026b; Kang et al., 2026; Ye et al., 2025; Hu et al., 2025），而基于分支的执行方式则仅返回紧凑的子任务结果（Sun et al., 2025）。 外部历史方法则通过保持活跃上下文受限，同时保留对提示之外早期交互的访问权限（Packer et al., 2024; Li et al., 2026），部分系统还会通过后续执行验证压缩后的表示形式，以减少信息损失（Chen et al., 2026b）。

sents.en: Existing methods reduce long-horizon context by compressing, pruning, summarizing, or selectively retrieving prior interactions ( Wei et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 现有方法通过压缩、剪枝、摘要生成或选择性检索过往交互来缩短长时程上下文（Wei et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Compression and pruning range from prompt-level compression ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) to removal of redundant or outdated interactions ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 压缩与剪枝的方法范围涵盖提示层级的压缩（Jiang et al., 2023; Jiang et al., 2024），到移除冗余或过时的交互（Xiao et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Summarization methods periodically replace accumulated interactions with compact reasoning states or learned summaries ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) , while branch-based execution can return only compact subtask results ( Sun et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 摘要生成方法会定期用紧凑的推理状态或学习到的摘要替换累积的交互（Wu et al., 2026b; Kang et al., 2026; Ye et al., 2025; Hu et al., 2025），而基于分支的执行方式则仅返回紧凑的子任务结果（Sun et al., 2025）。

sents.en: External-history methods instead keep the active context bounded while preserving access to earlier interactions outside the prompt ( Packer et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and some systems validate compressed representations against subsequent execution to reduce information loss ( Chen et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 外部历史方法则通过保持活跃上下文受限，同时保留对提示之外早期交互的访问权限（Packer et al., 2024; Li et al., 2026），部分系统还会通过后续执行验证压缩后的表示形式，以减少信息损失（Chen et al., 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Complementary approaches represent task progress explicitly, reducing reliance on raw interaction history alone. Some maintain an internal state by integrating prior memory with new observations ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , while others use structured representations, such as execution-state trees, persistent variables, or task records ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . Recent systems further externalize state into persistent workspaces and reconstruct the model’s working context through snapshots or programmatic selection ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Across these approaches, continuation is primarily organized around compressed interaction history or externally maintained state. Our approach instead makes reusable task objects the primary unit of continuation.

Reusable objects carry established progress for subsequent inspection and use, while explicit context retains complementary continuation information. Alongside the agent’s interaction loop, a Tracker identifies candidate reusable progress, which is bound to supporting evidence and, when applicable, checked by a Grounder . paragraphs.en: We organize the agent’s active context into three complementary components: continuation carriers , which expose reusable task objects; execution context , which preserves continuation information not captured by those carriers; and a live tail , which retains interactions accumulated since the latest fold.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将智能体的活跃上下文组织为三个互补的组成部分：延续载体，用于提供可重用的任务对象；执行上下文，用于保留这些载体未能捕捉到的延续信息；以及动态尾部，用于保存自最近一次折叠以来累积的交互。

paragraphs.en: External Objects : External objects are work products that exist independently in the environment and can be reopened or modified, such as code files, documents, and spreadsheets. Their carrier records reference the underlying objects and describe the progress they capture together with conditions for reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 外部对象：外部对象是独立存在于环境中的工作成果，可以重新打开或修改，例如代码文件、文档和电子表格。 它们的载体记录会引用底层对象，并描述它们所记录的流程以及可重复使用的条件。

paragraphs.zh: 情境状态：情境状态捕捉了仅在特定应用程序、会话或工作流程中可用的进度。 要重用此类进度，必须返回该状态所处的环境。 因此，其载体会记录环境锚点、已建立的状态以及该状态仍可重用的范围。

paragraphs.en: The Compiler proposes edits only for the selected candidates, grounding each edit in its authorized evidence. In contrast, the execution context is revised against the entire live tail to preserve continuation-relevant information. For external objects and situated state, the Compiler records reusable progress and its condition of use, while the underlying objects or states remain in the environment. For information products, it stores reusable findings directly in carrier records. In parallel, the Compiler revises execution context using the live tail, retaining active requirements and unfinished work not captured by carriers, including information outside the selected candidates. Upon successful validation, affected carriers receive successor versions, while unaffected carriers retain their existing records.
paragraphs.zh: 编译器仅对选定的候选项提出编辑，且每次编辑均有其授权证据作为依据。 相比之下，执行上下文则针对整个实时尾部进行修订，以保留与延续相关的信息。 对于外部对象和情境状态，编译器会记录可重用的进展及其使用条件，而底层的对象或状态仍保留在环境中。 对于信息产品，它会将可重用的发现直接存储到载体记录中。 同时，编译器利用实时尾部修订执行上下文，保留载体未涵盖的活跃需求和未完成工作，包括选定的候选项之外的信息。 验证成功后，受影响的载体将收到后续版本，而未受影响的载体则保留其现有记录。

A successful fold must introduce at least one carrier change; revising the execution context alone does not retire interaction history. These checks guard the runtime against inconsistent or unsupported updates; they do not verify task correctness.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate CarryOn on OSWorld 2.0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) and BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2025 ) to assess its performance across different types of long-horizon tasks. We use the full OSWorld 2.0 benchmark as our primary evaluation for its long execution horizons, complex workflows, and task diversity. We additionally evaluate our method on a randomly sampled subset of 100 BrowseComp-Plus questions, which require iterative search across multiple sources and provide a complementary setting for studying context management over long search histories. Benchmark details are provided in Appendix B.1 .

paragraphs.en: We analyze how CarryOn’s input context and cumulative cost evolve over the course of long-horizon execution on OSWorld 2.0. paragraphs.en: We conduct an ablation study on the shared 40-task OSWorld 2.0 subset by hiding either continuation carriers or execution context from the host agent. paragraphs.en: We introduce CarryOn, a context runtime that organizes long-horizon agent context around reusable task objects. Our method combines continuation carriers that expose reusable progress, execution context that preserves complementary goals, constraints, and unresolved issues, and a live tail of recent interactions. As the task progresses, CarryOn jointly updates continuation carriers and execution context to reflect evolving task state and remaining requirements, progressively replacing covered interaction history with an updated context view. On OSWorld 2.0, CarryOn raises partial score from 43.9% to 49.7% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and nominal model cost by 35.9%, including runtime overhead. On BrowseComp-Plus, it increases accuracy from 49% to 56% with lower token usage and cost. Together, these results support object-oriented context management for long-horizon agents, where task objects carry established progress and explicit context evolves with what is still needed to move forward.

sents.en: CarryOn maintains an append-only interaction log, a candidate registry, versioned carrier records, and execution-context revisions.
sents.zh: CarryOn 维护一个仅可追加的交互日志、一个候选者注册表、带版本标识的承运人记录以及执行上下文修订版本。

sents.en: The committed carrier records and execution context define the folded portion of the context view; subsequent interactions form the live tail.
sents.zh: 已提交的承运人记录和执行上下文定义了上下文视图的折叠部分；后续交互则构成动态尾部。

paragraphs.en: Each candidate has a runtime-assigned identifier, a provisional carrier type, a short description, and references to the interactions supporting it. Its identity fields specify the associated object or subject, and it may refer to an existing carrier whose progress is being updated. The registry records when the candidate was first observed and last revised. Candidates can persist across Tracker invocations, allowing progress to accumulate before compilation. Registering or revising a candidate does not itself trigger a fold.
paragraphs.zh: 每个候选项都有一个运行时分配的标识符、一个临时载体类型、一段简短描述，以及对支持其存在的交互的引用。 其身份字段指明了相关的对象或主体，并且可能引用一个正在更新进度的现有载体。 注册表记录了该候选项首次被观察到的时间和最后修订的时间。 候选项可以在多次调用 Tracker 的过程中持续存在，从而在编译前累积进度。 注册或修订候选项本身并不会触发折叠操作。

sents.zh: 候选项可以在多次调用 Tracker 的过程中持续存在，从而在编译前累积进度。

sents.en: Registering or revising a candidate does not itself trigger a fold.
sents.zh: 注册或修订候选项本身并不会触发折叠操作。

paragraphs.en: A committed carrier record contains its identity, carrier type, reusable content or object reference, conditions for continuation, applicability scope, provenance, and version information. External-object identities are derived from their normalized locations. Information-product identities combine a representation type with a structured subject, while situated-state identities combine a state domain with the subject of an environment anchor. These identity fields distinguish the object being tracked from its changing contents.
paragraphs.zh: 一个已提交的承载体记录包含其身份、承载体类型、可重复使用的内容或对象引用、延续条件、适用范围、来源和版本信息。 外部对象的身份源自其规范化后的位置。 信息产品的身份将一种表示类型与结构化主题相结合，而情境状态的身份则将一个状态域与环境锚点的主题相结合。 这些身份字段用于区分被跟踪的对象与其不断变化的内容。

sents.en: A committed carrier record contains its identity, carrier type, reusable content or object reference, conditions for continuation, applicability scope, provenance, and version information.
sents.zh: 一个已提交的承载体记录包含其身份、承载体类型、可重复使用的内容或对象引用、延续条件、适用范围、来源和版本信息。

sents.en: External-object identities are derived from their normalized locations.
sents.zh: 外部对象的身份源自其规范化后的位置。

sents.en: Information-product identities combine a representation type with a structured subject, while situated-state identities combine a state domain with the subject of an environment anchor.
sents.zh: 信息产品的身份将一种表示类型与结构化主题相结合，而情境状态的身份则将一个状态域与环境锚点的主题相结合。

sents.zh: 这些身份字段用于区分被跟踪的对象与其不断变化的内容。

paragraphs.en: Updating an existing carrier creates a successor record linked to the previous version. The successor becomes current, while earlier versions remain stored for provenance. Carriers not changed by a fold retain their current records. For information products, reusable content is stored as claims with identifiers, propositions, optional values, and supporting source references. Revisions can add, modify, or retract claims while carrying forward unaffected claims.
paragraphs.zh: 更新现有载体会创建一个与先前版本相关联的后继记录。 该后继版本将成为当前版本，而早期版本则会继续存储以保留来源信息。 未通过折叠操作更改的载体将保留其当前记录。 对于信息产品，可重复使用的内容将以声明的形式存储，其中包含标识符、命题、可选值以及支持性的来源引用。 修订可以添加、修改或撤回声明，同时保留未受影响的声明。

sents.en: Updating an existing carrier creates a successor record linked to the previous version.
sents.zh: 更新现有载体会创建一个与先前版本相关联的后继记录。

sents.en: The successor becomes current, while earlier versions remain stored for provenance.
sents.zh: 该后继版本将成为当前版本，而早期版本则会继续存储以保留来源信息。

sents.en: Carriers not changed by a fold retain their current records.
sents.zh: 未通过折叠操作更改的载体将保留其当前记录。

sents.zh: 修订可以添加、修改或撤回声明，同时保留未受影响的声明。

paragraphs.en: Execution context is stored as a revision associated with a committed fold. It contains the current focus, continuity information needed to resume work, open obligations, active constraints, and immediate continuation instructions. Entries retain source attribution. The Compiler revises this information against the proposed carrier updates, preserving unresolved requirements and removing items that have been resolved or are now represented by carriers.
paragraphs.zh: 执行上下文以与已提交的折叠相关联的修订版本形式存储。 它包含当前焦点、恢复工作所需的信息连续性、待办事项、有效约束以及即时延续指令。 条目保留来源归属信息。 编译器会将这些信息与拟议的载体更新进行比对，保留未解决的需求，并移除已解决或现由载体表示的项目。

sents.en: Execution context is stored as a revision associated with a committed fold.
sents.zh: 执行上下文以与已提交的折叠相关联的修订版本形式存储。

sents.en: It contains the current focus, continuity information needed to resume work, open obligations, active constraints, and immediate continuation instructions.
sents.zh: 它包含当前焦点、恢复工作所需的信息连续性、待办事项、有效约束以及即时延续指令。

sents.en: Entries retain source attribution.
sents.zh: 条目保留来源归属信息。

sents.en: The Compiler revises this information against the proposed carrier updates, preserving unresolved requirements and removing items that have been resolved or are now represented by carriers.
sents.zh: 编译器会将这些信息与拟议的载体更新进行比对，保留未解决的需求，并移除已解决或现由载体表示的项目。

paragraphs.en: At each invocation, the runtime performs the following operations:
paragraphs.zh: 在每次调用时，运行时都会执行以下操作：

paragraphs.en: The Tracker reads recent interactions and the candidate registry. The runtime applies admissible candidate updates and resolves any compilation requests to their candidate records.
paragraphs.zh: 追踪器读取最近的交互和候选者注册表。 运行时应用可接受的候选者更新，并将任何编译请求解析为对应的候选者记录。

sents.en: The Tracker reads recent interactions and the candidate registry.
sents.zh: 追踪器读取最近的交互和候选者注册表。

sents.en: The runtime applies admissible candidate updates and resolves any compilation requests to their candidate records.
sents.zh: 运行时应用可接受的候选者更新，并将任何编译请求解析为对应的候选者记录。

paragraphs.en: For each admitted request, the runtime binds the candidate snapshot, authorized prior carrier records, and supporting sources. Applicable environment checks contribute additional evidence. The resulting package fixes the records and evidence used for compilation. If no request is admitted, the invocation ends without a fold.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个被接受请求，运行时都会绑定候选快照、经授权的先前载体记录以及支持性来源。 适用的环境检查会提供额外的证据。 最终生成的包会确定用于编译的记录和证据。 如果没有请求被接受，调用将结束且不会生成折叠。

sents.en: For each admitted request, the runtime binds the candidate snapshot, authorized prior carrier records, and supporting sources.
sents.zh: 对于每个被接受请求，运行时都会绑定候选快照、经授权的先前载体记录以及支持性来源。

sents.en: Applicable environment checks contribute additional evidence.
sents.zh: 适用的环境检查会提供额外的证据。

sents.en: The resulting package fixes the records and evidence used for compilation.
sents.zh: 最终生成的包会确定用于编译的记录和证据。

sents.en: If no request is admitted, the invocation ends without a fold.
sents.zh: 如果没有请求被接受，调用将结束且不会生成折叠。

paragraphs.en: The Compiler proposes carrier additions or revisions together with a new execution context. Its input also includes the current execution context and a chronological text projection of the live tail, so continuation information outside the selected candidates can be retained.
paragraphs.zh: 编译器会提出载体的增补或修订，并附带一个新的执行上下文。 其输入还包括当前的执行上下文以及对实时尾部的时序文本投影，因此可以保留所选候选项之外的延续信息。

sents.en: The Compiler proposes carrier additions or revisions together with a new execution context.
sents.zh: 编译器会提出载体的增补或修订，并附带一个新的执行上下文。

sents.en: Its input also includes the current execution context and a chronological text projection of the live tail, so continuation information outside the selected candidates can be retained.
sents.zh: 其输入还包括当前的执行上下文以及对实时尾部的时序文本投影，因此可以保留所选候选项之外的延续信息。

paragraphs.en: The runtime checks identity and reference consistency, source authorization, output constraints, and whether the compilation input records remain current. A valid proposal must contain an actual carrier change. Acceptance atomically commits the carrier updates and execution-context revision and advances the fold boundary through the entire live tail. Rejection leaves these committed components and the live tail unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时检查身份和引用一致性、源授权、输出约束，以及编译输入记录是否保持最新。 有效的提案必须包含实际的载体变更。 接受操作会原子性地提交载体更新和执行上下文修订，并将折叠边界推进整个活跃尾部。 拒绝操作则保留这些已提交的组件和活跃尾部不变。

sents.en: The runtime checks identity and reference consistency, source authorization, output constraints, and whether the compilation input records remain current.
sents.zh: 运行时检查身份和引用一致性、源授权、输出约束，以及编译输入记录是否保持最新。

sents.en: A valid proposal must contain an actual carrier change.
sents.zh: 有效的提案必须包含实际的载体变更。

sents.en: Acceptance atomically commits the carrier updates and execution-context revision and advances the fold boundary through the entire live tail.
sents.zh: 接受操作会原子性地提交载体更新和执行上下文修订，并将折叠边界推进整个活跃尾部。

sents.en: Rejection leaves these committed components and the live tail unchanged.
sents.zh: 拒绝操作则保留这些已提交的组件和活跃尾部不变。

paragraphs.en: Previously accepted candidate updates remain available after a rejected compilation proposal. The original interactions remain in the log after a successful fold. Grounder rules and installation of the committed view are described in Appendices A.2 and A.3 , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在编译提案被拒绝后，先前接受的候选更新仍然可用。 在成功折叠后，原始交互仍保留在日志中。 基础规则以及对已提交视图的安装分别在第 A.2 和 A.3 附录中有描述。

sents.en: Previously accepted candidate updates remain available after a rejected compilation proposal.
sents.zh: 在编译提案被拒绝后，先前接受的候选更新仍然可用。

sents.en: The original interactions remain in the log after a successful fold.
sents.zh: 在成功折叠后，原始交互仍保留在日志中。

sents.en: Grounder rules and installation of the committed view are described in Appendices A.2 and A.3 , respectively.
sents.zh: 基础规则以及对已提交视图的安装分别在第 A.2 和 A.3 附录中有描述。

paragraphs.en: CarryOn aligns compilation requests with their supporting evidence. Information products undergo source-reference and excerpt checks. For object-bound requests, the Grounder performs scoped, read-only environment checks. Table 6 summarizes the implemented checks in the OSWorld 2.0 integration.
paragraphs.zh: CarryOn 将编译请求与其支持证据进行对齐。 信息产品会经过来源参考和摘录检查。 对于对象绑定请求，Grounder 会执行限定范围的只读环境检查。 表 6 总结了在 OSWorld 2.0 集成中实施的检查。

sents.en: CarryOn aligns compilation requests with their supporting evidence.
sents.zh: CarryOn 将编译请求与其支持证据进行对齐。

sents.en: Information products undergo source-reference and excerpt checks.
sents.zh: 信息产品会经过来源参考和摘录检查。

sents.en: For object-bound requests, the Grounder performs scoped, read-only environment checks.
sents.zh: 对于对象绑定请求，Grounder 会执行限定范围的只读环境检查。

sents.en: Table 6 summarizes the implemented checks in the OSWorld 2.0 integration.
sents.zh: 表 6 总结了在 OSWorld 2.0 集成中实施的检查。

paragraphs.en: Each check is bound to a candidate identity and revision, an object reference, a predicate, and an expected value before execution. The runtime records the observation and its provenance, and validates the binding against the current candidate before using the result.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行之前，每次检查都与一个候选身份和修订版本、一个对象引用、一个谓词以及一个预期值相关联。 运行时记录观察结果及其来源，并在使用结果之前，根据当前的候选项验证该关联关系。

sents.en: Each check is bound to a candidate identity and revision, an object reference, a predicate, and an expected value before execution.
sents.zh: 在执行之前，每次检查都与一个候选身份和修订版本、一个对象引用、一个谓词以及一个预期值相关联。

sents.en: The runtime records the observation and its provenance, and validates the binding against the current candidate before using the result.
sents.zh: 运行时记录观察结果及其来源，并在使用结果之前，根据当前的候选项验证该关联关系。

paragraphs.en: A condition is supported when the observation establishes the expected value, contradicted when it establishes an incompatible value, and unknown when the evidence cannot decide. A request is supported only when all declared conditions are supported. Any contradiction makes it contradicted. Otherwise, an unresolved condition makes it unknown.
paragraphs.zh: 当观察结果确立了预期值时，该条件即被支持；当观察结果确立了不相容的值时，该条件即被否定；而当证据无法做出判断时，该条件即为未知。 仅当所有声明的条件均被支持时，一项请求才会被支持。 任何矛盾都会使其被否定。 否则，未解决的条件会使其处于未知状态。

sents.en: A condition is supported when the observation establishes the expected value, contradicted when it establishes an incompatible value, and unknown when the evidence cannot decide.
sents.zh: 当观察结果确立了预期值时，该条件即被支持；当观察结果确立了不相容的值时，该条件即被否定；而当证据无法做出判断时，该条件即为未知。

sents.en: A request is supported only when all declared conditions are supported.
sents.zh: 仅当所有声明的条件均被支持时，一项请求才会被支持。

sents.en: Any contradiction makes it contradicted.
sents.zh: 任何矛盾都会使其被否定。

sents.en: Otherwise, an unresolved condition makes it unknown.
sents.zh: 否则，未解决的条件会使其处于未知状态。

paragraphs.en: Supported object-bound requests may proceed to compilation. Unsupported checks or unknown results leave the affected candidate uncompiled, while other admissible requests may proceed. If the interaction evidence supports an independently reusable information product, the Tracker may register a separate candidate through the source-validation route.
paragraphs.zh: 受支持的对象绑定请求可以进入编译阶段。 不受支持的检查或未知结果会使相关候选项保持未编译状态，而其他可接受的请求则可以继续处理。 如果交互证据支持一个可独立重用的信息产品，跟踪器可以通过源验证路径注册一个独立的候选项。

sents.en: Supported object-bound requests may proceed to compilation.
sents.zh: 受支持的对象绑定请求可以进入编译阶段。

sents.en: Unsupported checks or unknown results leave the affected candidate uncompiled, while other admissible requests may proceed.
sents.zh: 不受支持的检查或未知结果会使相关候选项保持未编译状态，而其他可接受的请求则可以继续处理。

sents.en: If the interaction evidence supports an independently reusable information product, the Tracker may register a separate candidate through the source-validation route.
sents.zh: 如果交互证据支持一个可独立重用的信息产品，跟踪器可以通过源验证路径注册一个独立的候选项。

paragraphs.en: These checks serve as supporting consistency safeguards within the runtime, helping the agent identify explicit contradictions and outstanding task requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 这些检查在运行时充当辅助一致性保障机制，帮助智能体识别明确的矛盾之处以及尚未完成的任务要求。

paragraphs.en: CarryOn runs alongside the agent through a benchmark-specific adapter. The adapter records interactions, supplies their textual representations and exposed thinking summaries to the runtime, and installs committed carrier records and execution context before the next agent call. Within each benchmark, the baseline and CarryOn use the same agent model, environment-action interface, and task budget. CarryOn additionally supplies the context-management interfaces and feedback described below.
paragraphs.zh: CarryOn 通过一个基准测试专用的适配器与智能体并行运行。 该适配器会记录交互过程，向运行时提供这些交互的文本表示和公开的思维摘要，并在下一次智能体调用之前安装已提交的载体记录和执行上下文。 在每个基准测试中，基线模型和 CarryOn 都使用相同的智能体模型、环境-动作接口以及任务预算。 CarryOn 还提供下文描述的上下文管理接口和反馈机制。

sents.en: CarryOn runs alongside the agent through a benchmark-specific adapter.
sents.zh: CarryOn 通过一个基准测试专用的适配器与智能体并行运行。

sents.en: The adapter records interactions, supplies their textual representations and exposed thinking summaries to the runtime, and installs committed carrier records and execution context before the next agent call.
sents.zh: 该适配器会记录交互过程，向运行时提供这些交互的文本表示和公开的思维摘要，并在下一次智能体调用之前安装已提交的载体记录和执行上下文。

sents.en: Within each benchmark, the baseline and CarryOn use the same agent model, environment-action interface, and task budget.
sents.zh: 在每个基准测试中，基线模型和 CarryOn 都使用相同的智能体模型、环境-动作接口以及任务预算。

sents.zh: CarryOn 还提供下文描述的上下文管理接口和反馈机制。

paragraphs.en: We use Claude Opus 4.7 for the agent, Tracker, and Compiler, without additional training. Table 7 lists their output limits and execution budgets. On OSWorld 2.0, the agent uses adaptive thinking at maximum effort; Tracker and Compiler requests contain no explicit thinking or effort override. On BrowseComp-Plus, the agent uses adaptive thinking with the provider’s default effort, the Tracker uses adaptive thinking at high effort, and the Compiler has thinking disabled. Both adapters expose the provider’s summarized thinking output to the runtime, marking it as agent-generated information rather than environment observations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Claude Opus 4.7 为智能体、追踪器和编译器提供能力，无需额外训练。 表 7 列出了它们的输出限制和执行预算。 在 OSWorld 2.0 中，智能体以最大努力程度使用自适应思考；追踪器和编译器的请求不包含显式的思考或努力覆盖指令。 在 BrowseComp-Plus 中，智能体以提供商的默认努力程度使用自适应思考，追踪器以高努力程度使用自适应思考，而编译器则禁用了思考功能。 两种适配器都将提供商总结的思考输出暴露给运行时，并将其标记为智能体生成的信息，而非环境观察结果。

sents.en: We use Claude Opus 4.7 for the agent, Tracker, and Compiler, without additional training.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Claude Opus 4.7 为智能体、追踪器和编译器提供能力，无需额外训练。

sents.en: Table 7 lists their output limits and execution budgets.
sents.zh: 表 7 列出了它们的输出限制和执行预算。

paragraphs.en: On OSWorld 2.0, the Tracker is normally invoked when interaction text accumulated since the previous scan or fold exceeds an estimated 6,000 tokens. These thresholds measure text volume, not predicted monetary savings.
paragraphs.zh: 在 OSWorld 2.0 中，当自上次扫描或折叠以来累积的交互文本超过估计的 6,000 个词元时，通常会调用 Tracker。 该估算值是将运行时文本投影的字符数除以四得出的，且不包含智能体的思考摘要。 这些阈值衡量的是文本量，而非预测的货币节省额。

Consecutive scans that produce no fold double the token thresholds, up to six doublings; a successful fold resets this backoff.

paragraphs.en: The adapter preserves the initial task message and installs a serialized checkpoint containing carrier records and execution context. It retains the contiguous suffix of complete message groups needed to preserve screenshots kept by the agent’s native image filter, together with the pending assistant message needed for protocol continuity. The native filter is configured with a recent-image threshold of 10, and screenshot eviction remains under its control. Retained tool calls, results, and signed thinking blocks preserve their protocol relationships. A fixed system instruction identifies the checkpoint as runtime-supplied context while treating its contents as task data.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器保留初始任务消息，并安装一个包含载体记录和执行上下文的序列化检查点。 它保留了完整消息组的连续后缀，这些后缀对于通过智能体原生图像过滤器保存的截图至关重要，同时还包括协议连续性所需的待处理助手消息。 原生过滤器的近期图像阈值配置为 10，且截图的淘汰仍由其控制。 保留的工具调用、结果和签名思考块保持其协议关系不变。 一条固定的系统指令将检查点识别为运行时提供的上下文，同时将其内容视为任务数据。

paragraphs.en: The agent uses BM25 search with up to five results per call and 512-token snippets, without full-document retrieval. The runtime receives bounded textual projections of search results, including document identifiers, ranks, scores, and the first 160 characters of each snippet, alongside agent text and exposed thinking summaries. After a fold, pending search results remain available to the next agent call.

paragraphs.en: Before installing a new context, the adapter snapshots the agent’s message state. A failed installation restores this snapshot and the previous active-checkpoint bookkeeping. If restoration is verified, execution continues with further runtime intervention disabled. If the previous state cannot be verified, the run stops with an error. This separates commitment of a runtime representation from its successful installation in the agent’s context.
paragraphs.zh: 在安装新上下文之前，适配器会快照智能体的消息状态。 如果安装失败，系统将恢复此快照以及之前的活动检查点记录。 如果恢复过程得到验证，执行将继续进行，且后续运行时干预将被禁用。 如果无法验证之前的状态，运行将因错误而停止。 这实现了运行时表示的提交与在智能体上下文中成功安装之间的分离。

paragraphs.en: OSWorld 2.0 contains long-horizon tasks spanning seven professional domains and 21 subcategories ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Its workflows combine desktop applications and web services, requiring cross-source reasoning, state tracking, and coordinated operations on multiple task outputs. The benchmark reports a median estimated human completion time of approximately 1.6 hours. The duration and diversity of these workflows make it suitable for evaluating context management over extended task execution. We use the v2026.08.08 release.
paragraphs.zh: OSWorld 2.0 包含长期任务，涵盖七个专业领域和 21 个子类别（Yuan 等人，2026）。 其工作流程结合了桌面应用程序和网络服务，需要跨源推理、状态跟踪以及对多个任务输出的协同操作。 该基准测试报告称，人类完成这些任务所需的预估时间中位数约为 1.6 小时。 这些工作流程的持续时间和多样性使其成为评估长期任务执行过程中上下文管理能力的有效工具。 我们使用的是 v2026.08.08 版本。

paragraphs.en: For Figure 4 (a), we compare current carrier records before and after each committed and installed fold. We examine all 494 committed and installed folds across the CarryOn trajectories included in this analysis. Carrier identities are tracked across record versions using registered identities and successor relations. A carrier is retained when its current record version is unchanged, updated when a successor version is committed, and added when it has no predecessor. Each carrier contributes one observation per fold in which it is present afterward. The same carrier can therefore contribute across several folds, and initial creations are included. Pooling these observations gives 278 retained, 372 updated, and 163 added observations, for 813 in total. The retained-or-updated proportion is 650 / 813 ≈ 79.95 % 650/813\approx 79.95\% , rounded to 80 % 80\% in the figure. These percentages describe record continuity across folds.
paragraphs.zh: 对于图 4(a)，我们比较了每次提交并安装的折叠前后当前的智能体记录。 我们检查了本分析所包含的 CarryOn 轨迹中所有 494 个已提交并安装的折叠。 通过已注册的身份和后续关系，可以在不同版本记录中追踪智能体的身份。 当智能体的当前记录版本未改变时，该智能体被保留；当后续版本被提交时，其记录被更新；当它没有前驱时，则被添加。 每个智能体在其之后存在的每个折叠中贡献一次观察值。 因此，同一个智能体可以在多个折叠中贡献观察值，并且初始创建的智能体也被包含在内。 将这些观察值汇总后，得到 278 个保留的观察值、372 个更新后的观察值和 163 个新增的观察值，总计 813 个。 保留或更新的比例为 650 / 813 ≈ 79.95 % 650/813\approx 79.95\% ，在图中四舍五入为 80 % 80\% 。 这些百分比描述了记录在不同折叠之间的连续性。

paragraphs.en: The Tracker and Compiler use separate system prompts. The runtime selects an environment, information-product, or composite Compiler route according to the authorized candidates. For presentation, prompt terminology is standardized to match the paper: continuation carriers (carriers for short), the host agent, and the runtime scheduler. An environment-check specification lists conditions for the Grounder to check; selected evidence forms part of the compilation input package U t U_{t} . Internal policy labels, development annotations, and serialization-version tags are omitted. JSON field names and categorical values retain their implementation spelling.
paragraphs.zh: 追踪器和编译器使用独立的系统提示。 运行时根据授权候选项选择环境、信息产品或组合编译器路径。 为便于展示，提示术语已标准化以与论文保持一致：延续载体（简称载体）、主机智能体以及运行时调度器。 环境检查规范列出了基础器需要检查的条件；选定的证据构成编译输入包 U t U_{t} 的一部分。 内部策略标签、开发注释和序列化版本标签均已省略。 JSON 字段名和分类值保留其实现中的拼写形式。

paragraphs.en: The Tracker receives the task and current committed records, the live tail, and a current-state block containing candidates and runtime feedback. paragraphs.en: GS and CGS receive the current visible conversation, including the task, any earlier summary, and recent messages. The input preserves message roles, tool actions, returned observations, visible images, and returned reasoning summaries where available. They return a replacement summary as plain text.
paragraphs.zh: GS 和 CGS 接收当前可见的对话内容，包括任务、任何早期的摘要以及最近的消息。 输入保留了消息角色、工具操作、返回的观察结果、可见图像以及可用的推理摘要。 它们以纯文本形式返回一个替代摘要。
